offering.title: DACS attestation-bundle verification (d402)
offering.description: DACS attestation-bundle verification behind a d402 payment gate: POST /verify, 402 until paid, verdict plus an HTTP receipt that names the on-chain payment. Pricing and the other three services: commerce/offers.json.

x-pathos.draft: unsigned DACS-1 §6.3.4 draft. The x-pathos block is not a §6.3.4 member: remove it before signing (listing-pub refuses a record that still carries it). The verdict payload is self-signed by the service's own key (DPA-1 verificationMethod self-signed): key possession, not an independent attestation.
x-pathos.publish: at deploy, in this order: (1) present the seller identity under the deployer wallet's agent DID (listing-wire presentIdentity) and set seller.identity; (2) set validity.notBefore and logical_address = dacs1:{CF-4 seller DID}:pathos-verify-bundle:v1; (3) remove this x-pathos block; (4) sign the remaining record with listing-wire signDacs1Listing (or the producer-listing helper); (5) anchor with `npm run listing-pub -- --listing-file <signed> --mnemonic-env <ENV> --publisher-origin <origin>`, which verifies the record first. This file is never indexed as is.
